comparison.objective: Drive a piston and its compressed rings into an engine bore while holding the compressor flat; candidate tunes a damper and validates stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual downward force coordination and ring containment versus tool insertion, fine rotary adjustment, bounded locking torque and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: All rings enter without escape while the compressor remains within its deck gap limit; candidate requires two acceptable impacts without bottoming or drift. Candidate rebound/overload/drift thresholds remain unspecified.
comparison.reason: The piston task tests simultaneous constraint holding and insertion, not adjustment or dynamic-response commissioning.
